Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray shows discrete areas of hypotransparency (opacities) in the upper zones of both hemithoraces, with the opacity on the right side being visibly larger and more pronounced than the one on the left. This asymmetry, combined with the bilateral upper lobe involvement, is most consistent with a progression or exacerbation of a previously diagnosed right-sided pneumonia that has now involved the contralateral side or worsened locally.
